sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MIDLEVEL TROUGH INITIALLY OVER THE OZARK PLATEAU WILL TRANSLATE ENEWD THROUGH THE OH/TN VALLEYS IN RESPONSE TO UPSTREAM JET STREAK/VORTICITY MAXIMUM DIGGING SEWD THROUGH THE UPPER GREAT LAKES. THIS LARGE-SCALE PATTERN EVOLUTION WILL RESULT IN STRONG DYNAMIC FORCING/HEIGHT FALLS SPREADING EWD ACROSS THE MID/LOWER MS AND OH/TN RIVER VALLEYS. THESE INCREASED HEIGHT FALLS AND GRADUAL OPENING OF MIDLEVEL WAVE WILL SERVE TO DEEPEN ATTENDANT SURFACE LOW WHICH WILL DEVELOP FROM SERN MO NEWD TO NEAR THE IND/OH BORDER BY MONDAY MORNING. AS THIS OCCURS...TRAILING COLD FRONT WILL PUSH EWD THROUGH THE LOWER MS AND TN VALLEYS AND CNTRL GULF STATES. ...LOWER OH/MS VALLEYS EWD INTO THE TN VALLEY AND CNTRL GULF STATES... REMNANTS OF MCS CURRENTLY PRESENT OVER PORTIONS OF MS/LA ARE EXPECTED TO BE ONGOING AT THE ONSET OF THE FORECAST PERIOD...FUELED BY INFLUX OF LOWER/MID 60S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS ALONG 40-50 KT LLJ. THIS LLJ IS EXPECTED TO MIGRATE NEWD INTO THE APPALACHIANS TODAY...THOUGH SWRN EXTENSION OF THIS FEATURE WILL MAINTAIN MODEST LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IN ADVANCE OF MCS MOVING EWD ACROSS PARTS OF MS/AL AND THE FL PNHDL. sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE MID LEVEL LOW OVER NE OK IS IN THE PROCESS OF EVOLVING INTO AN OPEN WAVE IN RESPONSE TO UPSTREAM HEIGHT FALLS WITH A NRN STREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH THAT HAS CRESTED THE NRN ROCKIES RIDGE AND IS NOW MOVING SEWD TOWARD THE UPPER MS VALLEY. THE OK TROUGH WILL PROGRESS EWD ACROSS THE MID SOUTH TODAY AND THEN NEWD TO THE SRN/CENTRAL APPALACHIANS OVERNIGHT...WHILE AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE CYCLONE MOVES NEWD FROM SE MO TO INDIANA AND GRADUALLY DEEPENS.

sections.title: MS/TN VALLEY REGION TODAY THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: A LOOSE BAND OF PRE-FRONTAL CONVECTION WILL PRECEDE THE MID LEVEL TROUGH AXIS ACROSS MS/AL TODAY...WITH LOW-LEVEL WAA PROVIDING THE ASCENT TO MAINTAIN THE PRECIPITATION BAND. EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS/BOWS WILL STILL BE POSSIBLE THIS MORNING ACROSS THE LA DELTA WITHIN THIS BAND AND SOME OF THE STRONGER CONVECTION COULD ALSO REACH SRN AL...THOUGH THE MOST INTENSE STORMS WILL LIKELY REMAIN OFFSHORE. ATTENTION THEN TURNS TO SURFACE COLD FRONT WHICH IS MOVING EWD ACROSS E TX. THIS BOUNDARY WILL TRANSLATE EWD TO NEAR THE MS RIVER AROUND 21Z...AND WRN AL BY ROUGHLY 03Z. E OF THE COLD FRONT...BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS WILL INCREASE TO THE LOW 60S ACROSS WRN TN AND THE UPPER 60S ALONG THE N CENTRAL GULF COAST. SURFACE HEATING ALONG THE MOIST AXIS /W OF THE MORNING BAND OF CLOUDS AND RAIN/ WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF MODERATE INSTABILITY /MLCAPE VALUES OF 750-1500 J/KG/. THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED BY EARLY-MID AFTERNOON ALONG AND JUST AHEAD OF THE FRONT/SURFACE LOW FROM NE AR/SE MO SWD ACROSS WRN TN INTO NW MS. THE CONVECTION NEAR AND N OF I-40 WILL PRESENT A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS GIVEN THE COOL MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES AND RATHER WEAK LOW-LEVEL SHEAR. FARTHER S I

sections.title: KY/TN
sections.text: CLOUD COVER IS THINNING ACROSS AR AND WESTERN TN/MS THIS MORNING AS MID LEVEL DRY SLOT ROTATES ACROSS REGION. MEANWHILE...THE SURFACE COLD FRONT AND BACK EDGE OF SURFACE MOISTURE LIES FROM WEST OF LIT TO EAST OF SHV. DAYTIME HEATING AND SLOW MOISTURE TRANSPORT INTO THE AREA AHEAD OF THE FRONT WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000 J/KG FROM WESTERN KY INTO MS. THE POCKET OF COLD MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES AND LARGE SCALE FORCING NEAR THE UPPER TROUGH WILL LIKELY PROMOTE SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY MID AFTERNOON OVER PARTS OF NORTHEAST AR/SOUTHEAST MO...SPREADING INTO ADJACENT PARTS OF KY/TN. STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL PROMOTE ORGANIZED/SUPERCELL STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: MS/AL/TN
sections.text: FARTHER SOUTH...STRONG SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL CONTINUE TO TRANSPORT GULF MOISTURE NORTHWARD WITH DEWPOINTS CLIMBING INTO THE LOWER/MID 60S ACROSS THE AREA. MOST OPERATIONAL AND MESOSCALE MODELS AGREE WITH THE SCENARIO OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING DURING THE MID/LATE AFTERNOON AS COLD FRONT MOVES INTO MS. MLCAPE OF AROUND 1000 J/KG AND STRONG DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL PROMOTE THE RISK OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. MODELS ALSO SUGGEST THAT PARTS OF NORTHERN MS/AL WILL MAINTAIN SUBSTANTIAL LOW LEVEL SHEAR THROUGH PARTS OF THE EVENING...WHICH COULD ENHANCE THE RISK OF ISOLATED TORNADOES. ACTIVITY IS LIKELY TO WEAKEN BY 06Z AS STORMS MOVE INTO MORE STABLE AIRMASS OVER EASTERN TN AND GA. ..HART/GARNER.. 04/19/2009

sections.title: ERN MS/AL/WRN FL PANHANDLE/ERN TN
sections.text: REGIONAL RADARS/SATELLITE IMAGERY/LIGHTNING DATA INDICATED TSTMS CONTINUED TO DEVELOP ALONG AND EAST OF PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH...WHICH AT 19Z EXTENDED FROM NERN MS/NWRN AL TO SERN MS. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE CONFINED TO A NARROW CORRIDOR WITH THE WRN EXTENT BEING THE PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH AND ERN EXTENT ALONG LEADING EDGE OF GREATER MOISTURE RETURN /SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 60S/. FORCING FOR ASCENT AHEAD OF COMPACT AR SHORT WAVE TROUGH AND WITHIN DIFFLUENT MID/UPPER LEVEL FLOW DOWNSTREAM OF TROUGH WILL MAINTAIN LIKELIHOOD FOR ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-40 KT WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS. TSTMS DEVELOPMENT HAS BEEN MORE PERSISTENT ACROSS NERN MS/NWRN AL...GIVEN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT AHEAD OF AR SHORT WAVE TROUGH. DEEP SWLY FLOW SUGGESTS THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD REMAIN MORE QUASI-LINEAR WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS. FARTHER S...A WEAK BOUNDARY EXTENDED FROM THE WRN FL PANHANDLE NWWD THROUGH SWRN AL. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED LOW LEVEL SRH ENHANCED IN THE VICINITY OF THIS BOUNDARY AND ALSO ALONG LLJ FROM SERN MS TO NRN AL. THUS...STORMS DEVELOPING WITHIN THIS AREA WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING A TORNADO. NRN EX

sections.title: ERN AR EWD THROUGH TN VALLEY
sections.text: FORCING FOR ASCENT AHEAD OF COMPACT AR SHORT WAVE TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STRONG TO SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT FROM ONGOING ACTIVITY IN ERN AR/NRN MS AND EWD TO MIDDLE TN/NRN AL BY THIS EVENING AS THE TROUGH PROGRESSES EWD. MODERATE INSTABILITY ALONG NRN EXTENT OF MOISTURE RETURN INTO LOWER TN VALLEY AND STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR /40-55 KT/ ATTENDANT TO CORE OF STRONGER MID LEVEL FLOW WILL FAVOR ADDITIONAL SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT. STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT A LARGE HAIL THREAT...WHILE BACKED SURFACE WINDS INCREASING HODOGRAPH CURVATURE OVER NERN MS/NWRN AL MAY ENHANCE THE TORNADO THREAT AS NRN MS ACTIVITY DEVELOPS/SPREAD EWD. ..PETERS.. 04/19/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1125 AM CDT SUN APR 19 2009/ UPPER LOW OVER NORTHWEST AR IS FORECAST TO OPEN UP AND ROTATE NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE MID MS AND OH VALLEYS TODAY. MEANWHILE...THE MAIN SURFACE LOW WILL TRACK FROM SOUTHEAST MO INTO IND. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY AND MORNING U/A ANALYSIS SHOW A LARGE DRY SLOT THAT WILL OVERSPREAD MUCH OF THE WARM SECTOR OF THE LOW TODAY ACROSS THE OH/TN VALLEYS. THIS MAY SET THE STAGE FOR SCATTERED STRONG/SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING.
